events.subtitle: CROSSOVER NIGHT 2026
events.factual_description: Yasuko Agawa's official schedule and Billboard Live Tokyo list CROSSOVER NIGHT 2026 for Thursday, September 10, 2026 at Billboard Live Tokyo, with first-set doors at 16:00 and start at 17:00, and second-set doors at 19:00 and start at 20:00. The announced lineup is Yasuko Agawa on vocals, Masanori Sasaji on keyboards, Bakabon Suzuki on bass, Chisei Tsurutani on drums, Koichi Yabori on guitar, and Ryoji Ihara on saxophone. Agawa's official site describes her as a vocalist who helped drive Japan's 1980s jazz boom and later won renewed respect in club culture, noting collaborations with Sergio Mendes, Joe Sample, Tommy Flanagan, and Pino Palladino. Billboard frames the night around her jazz/fusion and club-scene lineage. Agawa's official schedule shows the same CROSSOVER NIGHT concept recurring in 2025 and lists a second 2026 date at Billboard Live Osaka on September 22, which makes the Tokyo performance a recurring series rather than a one-off scarcity event. Listed single-seat prices are ¥8,800 to ¥15,000; Duo seating is sold in pairs at ¥21,900 or ¥23,000.

en.why_it_matters: Agawa's crossover story is unusually legible in this room. Her career helped carry Japanese jazz vocals into the 1980s jazz/fusion boom and later into club culture, and this six-piece band keeps that history musical rather than nostalgic: Sasaji, Suzuki, Tsurutani, Yabori and Ihara give her voice keyboards, electric rhythm section, guitar and saxophone to move between jazz polish and crossover groove. It is a useful live snapshot of a Japanese lineage that kept changing audiences without abandoning musicianship.
en.trip_verdict: If September 10 is open while you are in Tokyo, this is worth an evening at Billboard Live, especially if the trip is following Japanese jazz/fusion lineage beyond piano trios. I would not rearrange a Kanto itinerary around it, because the CROSSOVER NIGHT format is recurring and the same 2026 tour continues to Osaka.

es.why_it_matters: La historia de crossover de Agawa se entiende especialmente bien en esta sala. Su carrera ayudó a llevar la voz de jazz japonesa al boom de jazz y fusión de los ochenta y después a la cultura de club, y este sexteto mantiene esa historia en el terreno musical, no en la nostalgia: Sasaji, Suzuki, Tsurutani, Yabori e Ihara rodean su voz con teclados, sección rítmica eléctrica, guitarra y sax para moverse entre el pulido del jazz y el groove crossover. Es una buena fotografía en vivo de una línea japonesa que fue cambiando de público sin soltar el oficio musical.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 10 de septiembre está libre mientras estás en Tokio, vale la pena dedicarle la noche en Billboard Live, sobre todo si el viaje viene siguiendo la línea japonesa de jazz y fusión más allá de los tríos de piano. No reorganizaría un itinerario por Kanto alrededor de esta fecha, porque CROSSOVER NIGHT es un formato recurrente y la gira de 2026 continúa después en Osaka.
